editorial.blurb: A welcoming sushi spot where fresh, made-to-order rolls and creative sides like kimchi fries keep regulars coming back as part of their weekly ritual.
editorial.insiderTip: Come right after they reopen for dinner for a quieter experience, and note that the 50% off maki rolls are half-size—you'll likely need to order two.
signatureDishes: Mexican Nori Roll with Escolar, Jalapeño and Cilantro
